title: Flimsy
text: Flimsy. The silverware baskets tilt out more than the photo shows. It’s weird that the greatest weight goes on the top. I hate to criticize this item but I was disappointed. Of course, it is also relatively inexpensive and I wanted to save space so I kept it.

product_metadata.title: Simple Houseware 2-Tier Dish Rack with Drainboard, White
features: Classic white coating finish 2 tier dish rack with black drainboard, cutlery bucket and cutting board holder.
Stylish design and color fit mostly kitchen decoration.
Rack with sturdy metal construction; two layers shelf with Mug holder enable to hold full size dinner plates, bowl, cup, etc.
Detachable cutlery bucket with drainage spot and drainboard one side opening easily drain out water.
Measurement: Rack: 17.75"Lx11.5"Wx13"H; Cutlery Bucket: 7"Lx 3"W x 4"H; Drainboard: 17"Lx 11.5"W x 0.75"H
